summary: Verified AdminHeader fix across all admin pages. Navigation links (Quotations, Invoices, Products, Customers, Shop Orders, Contacts, Settings, Logout) are correctly displayed and functional. Fixed bug in AdminCustomersPage that was using wrong token key.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: AdminCustomersPage.jsx was using localStorage.getItem('token') instead of localStorage.getItem('adminToken') - causing 401 errors on customers API calls
context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminHeader navigation verified on all admin pages. AdminCustomersPage token bug fixed. Product deletion button works correctly (P1 bug not present). All 7 admin pages load with correct AdminHeader showing all required links.
